dct_description_sm: This project focuses on buried glacier ice exposed on a plateau located at the southwest end of Bylot Island, in the Canadian High Arctic. This project has three specific objectives: 1) to characterize the cryofacies and chemico-physical characteristics of the buried glacier ice found on Bylot Island and modern glacier ice; 2) to reconstruct climatic and environmental history of Bylot Island at different moments of the Pleistocene (Plio-Pleistocene transition to Late Pleistocene) 3) to compare climatic reconstruction based on our results with existing regional paleoclimatic models. This study will help to develop a genetic classification of buried massive ice based on the physico-chemical properties of ice. Data was also collected in order to identify and quantify the changes in the climate that occurred rapidly on Bylot Island at the Plio-Pleistocene boundary.
dct_title_s: Physical and chemical data of buried glacier ice found on Bylot Island (Nunavut)
